caseName: S. T. ex rel. N. T. v. Board of Education of Millville
caseNameFull: S. T., on Behalf of her Minor Child, N. T. v. Board of Education of the City of Millville, New Jersey

opinions.text: Appeal from Super. Ct. N. J., App. Div., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
